page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5ge.48xlarge is a high-density, storage-heavy cloud server instance provisioned via KVM hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 architecture, this instance features 192 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. To support intensive parallel execution, it is configured with 1152 GB of RAM, offering a allocation of 6 GB of memory per vCPU core.

A primary feature of the ecs.i5ge.48xlarge is its integrated local storage array, providing 30717 GB of local SSD capacity directly attached to the host. Network connectivity is scaled to a baseline bandwidth of 190 Gbps, accommodating high throughput requirements without discrete GPU reliance, as no dedicated GPU acceleration hardware is included in this instance model.

From an engineering perspective, the hardware layout presents strong qualitative cost efficiency for IO-bound and memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Combining 192 execution threads with massive local SSD storage reduces the need for expensive external block storage attachments. This server is suitable for large-scale relational or non-relational databases, distributed file systems, high-throughput analytics pipelines, and data warehousing engines.
